feature: Near-side A-roof to B-roof distance divided by same-view wheelbase
interpretation: The intervals do not overlap even after allowing both feature and axle endpoints their full declared uncertainties. A common longitudinal affine calibration cannot fit these correspondences. Translation, cage resampling and a mean error cannot fix this ratio. This is not proof that all possible perspective calibration models are impossible; source correspondence/projection needs review. No nonlinear source warp or different geometry per view is used.
